title: Deferred - External User Validation
description: Optional future validation retained outside the technical product-hardening milestone. It may be reactivated later if Boreal needs an unassisted external-user cohort, but it is not required for current business-logic or technical-readiness work.
acceptanceCriteria: When explicitly reactivated, define the external cohort, protocol, non-coaching rules, privacy boundary, and success thresholds before recruitment.
External behavior is reported as evidence without overstating causality or treating abandonment as user error.
This work is not a dependency of the technical product-hardening milestone.
